## #2 — frank beckmann — 2009-03-09
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/3974/post-27675>

Hi and welcome.
I would recommend  not to use "Automatic Seams"; just setting seams for the upper&bottom surfaces and 2 additional seams at "north&south" for the height. Than group select one after another and scale&arrange the UVs within the texture field.

With kindest regards
Frank
